subject: rank-1 Earth primary Boulder construction, draw, release, and breakup

ghidra.mode: headless, existing analyzed project copied to a disposable project, -readOnly -noanalysis

functions.role: Earth primary dispatcher and cached actor owner
held growth, glimmer mix, shell rebuild edge, called-rock emission, flight contact dispatch
rebuild central rock plus Fibonacci-sphere shell
initialize Boulder orientation matrix to identity with zero translation
glimmer crossfade, matrix transform, depth sort, and main rock draw
orthographic projection helper; copy transformed X/Y and ignore Z
post-contact rock/bounds update and breakup dispatch
Anim_Bouncer gated motion, gravity, bounce, rotation, and base fade tick
ZAnimLitObject full render entry through Puppet_RenderDispatch
Puppet common cull, Region-light modulation, and draw dispatcher

assets.role: opening glimmer only; never the boulder body
main depth-sorted body variants; 171 is the central pebble
lit called-rock and breakup fragment variants

render_contract.shell_point_count: ceil(30 * charge), plus one central variant-3 rock
render_contract.shell_point_distribution: Fibonacci sphere: y = 2*i/n - 1 + 1/n, theta = i*pi*(3-sqrt(5)); normalized to radius 30*charge
render_contract.crossfade: record 86 alpha/mix is m; body alpha is 1-m; m starts at 1 and loses 0.035 per tick until zero
render_contract.ordering: transform local XYZ by Boulder +0x154 matrix, keep strict transformed Z > -40, sort ascending transformed Z, then draw main bank; rank-1 radius <= 30 makes the cull branch unreachable for valid shell rocks
render_contract.projection: 0x0043A8A0 copies transformed X/Y exactly and ignores Z; registration is Boulder actor transform plus that orthographic XY offset
render_contract.orientation: while held, rotate +0x154 by 0.75 degrees/tick about normalized axis (0,-0.8,1); preserve the final matrix unchanged in flight

lighting.boulder: vslot +0x0C is Puppet_RenderDispatch; sample inbound Region light at Boulder world XY; no recovered outbound light
lighting.called_rock: direct world-animation vslot +0x0C bypasses Puppet_RenderDispatch and ZAnimLitObject; no inbound Region sample and no outbound light
lighting.breakup_fragment: independent ZAnimLitObject wrapper copies fragment XY, uses Puppet_RenderDispatch for inbound Region light, and has no outbound-light intensity/range fields
lighting.shadow: no direct BadGuys[67] shadow reference exists in Boulder draw

visual_samples: optional dust and loose fragment emission
breakup fragment variant, direction, placement, scale, and lifetime
randomness.web_consequence: seed visual choices from stable spell/particle identity; never consume authoritative gameplay RNG

lifecycle.hold: one cached actor follows the live staff emitter and aim while charge grows
lifecycle.release: 0x005E5450 flips +0x1DC/+0x1DD from held to flight without replacing identity
lifecycle.flight: straight motion and 0x00620B60 contact query every native tick; the actor position is velocity-advanced before the query, so terminal breakup registers at that advanced sample; no native fixed timeout recovered
lifecycle.impact: 0x0060B700 restores saved charge, emits independently rooted Anim_BoulderBit children inside ZAnimLitObject wrappers, registers the wrappers, then removes the Boulder; the semantic event must retain native global birth tick for modulo-three motion
lifecycle.interruption: dispatcher/player primary transition and world actor teardown stop gather ownership; destructor clears both lists; web owner removal, death, scene replacement, and disconnect must remove the semantic actor/effects and balance loops

historical_capture.classification: instrumented stock multiplayer observer evidence; not a clean-stock rerun
historical_capture.interpretation: shows an assembled multi-rock cluster at the caster's right-hand/staff emitter with the bright opening glimmer behind it; it corroborates composition and attachment but is not an exact timing/count oracle

bounded_unknowns: A clean-stock 2026-08-14 hold/release/terrain-impact capture was unavailable because unrelated isolated stock processes owned the desktop.
The exact shared-RNG seed/order and its interleaving with unrelated actors are unrecovered and intentionally not promoted into browser gameplay state.
The current web combat model has no native target damage/contact continuation lane; terrain contact and visual breakup can be authoritative without claiming the unreconstructed residual-damage rules.
No direct Boulder shadow sprite call was recovered; generic world lighting/tint remains a sibling renderer responsibility.
